defects: Mohammed is staged in three-quarter rear view with his back to the camera during his dialogue beat.
tiles.fix: Open up Mohammed's body angle slightly toward the camera so his profile reads clearly when he asks his mother.

defects: Mohammed remains turned away from the camera in three-quarter rear view while speaking.
tiles.fix: Rotate Mohammed slightly toward camera so his face and question gesture read clearly.

defects: Zoubida points horizontally toward Mohammed's head/shoulder instead of pointing down at the stains on his djellaba as required by b068.
tiles.fix: Angle Zoubida's right forearm and index finger downward toward the lower front of Mohammed's djellaba.

defects: Fatma Bziouya in the right-hand doorway is missing her little broom ('petit balai') required by b069 and the subtitle; her hands are empty.
Fatma Bziouya stands upright inside the doorway rather than leaning out.
tiles.fix: Put the small hand broom prop in Fatma Bziouya's hand and pose her leaning forward out of the right-hand doorway.

defects: Fatma Bziouya is still missing her little broom prop in the right-hand doorway.
Zoubida and Mohammed keep looking at each other on the left instead of noticing Fatma Bziouya on the right.
tiles.fix: Give Fatma Bziouya her little broom prop and turn Zoubida's head and gaze toward the right-hand doorway.

defects: Zoubida on the left edge of the frame is looking left (out of frame, away from Fatma Bziouya) while Fatma Bziouya asks her a question from the right-hand doorway.
Fatma Bziouya is still missing her little broom prop.
tiles.fix: Turn Zoubida's head and torso to face right toward Fatma Bziouya's doorway, and add the broom prop to Fatma Bziouya's hand.

defects: Zoubida continues looking left out of frame with her back turned to Fatma Bziouya while being addressed from the right doorway.
Fatma Bziouya is missing her little broom prop.
tiles.fix: Keep Zoubida facing and looking right at Fatma Bziouya in the doorway, and include Fatma's broom prop.

defects: Brief b071 specifies 'Zoubida keeps her eyes on that doorway and nods', but Zoubida is facing and looking left at Mohammed with her back to the right-hand doorway.
Fatma Bziouya in the right doorway is still missing her broom.
tiles.fix: Rotate Zoubida's head and gaze toward the right-hand doorway while nodding to Fatma Bziouya, and equip Fatma with her broom.

defects: Zoubida is still looking left at Mohammed instead of keeping her eyes on the right-hand doorway and nodding as required by b071.
Fatma Bziouya is still missing her broom prop.
tiles.fix: Have Zoubida face and look toward the right-hand doorway for the nod beat, and add the broom prop to Fatma Bziouya.

defects: Maâlem Abdeslem is already standing inside the courtyard in front of the left arch rather than calling from the left street doorway before entering (b072–b073).
Both Mohammed and Zoubida have their backs turned to Maâlem Abdeslem on the left, failing to look toward the street door when he calls.
tiles.fix: Stage Maâlem Abdeslem at the threshold of the left street doorway calling in, and turn Mohammed and Zoubida's heads left toward him.

defects: Maâlem Abdeslem is already inside the patio before being told 'Passe', and Mohammed and Zoubida remain turned away from him looking right/at each other.
tiles.fix: Keep Maâlem Abdeslem back in the left street doorway threshold until b073, and turn Zoubida and Mohammed to look left toward his voice.

defects: Brief b073 specifies 'Passe: only then does he walk in', but Maâlem Abdeslem stands stationary in the exact same spot as b072 in an idle pose instead of walking in.
Zoubida and Mohammed still have their backs turned to Maâlem Abdeslem on the left.
tiles.fix: Animate Maâlem Abdeslem stepping forward from the left doorway into the courtyard on 'Passe', and orient Zoubida and Mohammed toward him.

defects: Maâlem Abdeslem remains planted in place in an idle standing pose rather than walking into the patio on b073.
Zoubida and Mohammed are still turned away from Maâlem Abdeslem, looking at each other instead of toward him on the left.
tiles.fix: Show Maâlem Abdeslem mid-stride walking into the courtyard from the left door and have Zoubida and Mohammed look left toward him.

worst_problem: Zoubida never looks at the right-hand doorway when Fatma Bziouya speaks and when Zoubida nods to her (b070–b071), Fatma Bziouya's broom prop is completely missing (b069), and Maâlem Abdeslem is already standing motionless inside the courtyard instead of calling from the doorway and walking in on 'Passe' while Zoubida and Mohammed keep their backs turned to him (b072–b073).
